notes.title: Improvements to bots / Fixes bug where game opens other tabs
notes.content:
- Fixes a bug where the game opens tabs in the taskbar on some devices
- Minor fixes to gunshot audio
- Please ensure that the resolution is correct for your display and that you are on fullscreen for the best gameplay experience. 
- All bugs and suggestions can be directed on our DISCORD (link in store page)
